Great food in an oasis of calm
Jun 2024 • Friends
What a find! If you’re after something a little less Vietnamese you’ve come to the right place. 
Situated opposite the Pink Catholic Church this 3 level restaurant and bar has huge windows overlooking the church. The interior is beautiful - at the same time casual and sophisticated, with an air of fun. 
There is outdoor dining on the top floor also. 
The food is delicious. A fusion of Asian and Hawaiian, it’s beautifully presented and very tasty. If you’re having trouble deciding go with the Tacos and choose 2 different fillings. I had pulled pork in one, fish in the other. Yum! 
The waiting staff were very attentive and service could not have been better. In saying that we were there at a quiet time
